content: {"episode_id":"ep-05020","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the denial of CPT 93229 based on the documented clinical indication, acknowledging that prior authorization is missing. The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia. Given the intermittent symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture and characterize the underlying arrhythmias."}
